title: Maharashtra Approves ₹45-Crore Eco-Nature Park with India's 1st AI Bird Monitoring Centre at Thane Creek
summary: Integrates AI acoustic sensors and automated camera tracking into coastal Ramsar wetland conservation.

blocks.content: Integrates AI acoustic sensors and automated camera tracking into coastal Ramsar wetland conservation.

items: Project Location: Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary shoreline (Bhandup Bird Park project, 20.09 hectares total, 0.35 hectares physical footprint).
Technology Footprint: Uses AI-based cameras and acoustic sensors across a 1.5-km stretch to track bird activity along the Central Asian Flyway.
Funding Allocation: ₹45 crore sanctioned from District Planning Committee special fund.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Thane Creek declared wildlife sanctuary in 2015 (India's 1st dedicated flamingo sanctuary) | Designated Ramsar site.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: India's 1st dedicated flamingo sanctuary (Thane Creek, 2015) vs India's 101st Ramsar site (Glaw Lake, Arunachal Pradesh).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "How does AI-driven acoustic monitoring improve wetland conservation along the Central Asian Flyway?"
💡 **Model Answer: Automated real-time image and sound recognition tracks migratory species populations without human environmental disturbance.**
blocks.author: Banking & Regulatory Board Panel
